name: First Time?
look: A film still of James Franco as a scruffy cowboy with a thick rope noose around his neck, smiling wryly over his shoulder under a pale sky beside a wooden gallows post. An older man with white hair sits at left. The subtitle reads "-First time?"
use: A seasoned veteran calmly teases a panicking newcomer. The caption sets up something stressful that someone is going through for the first time, and the unbothered cowboy, who has clearly been here before, asks "First time?"
slots: the stressful situation and the panicking newcomer (caption above)
examples: When the new hire panics because the printer jammed again
Me, eight years at this office
